description: User can archive all completed tasks in one click via an "Archive completed" button at the bottom of the task list
objective: On https://taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app/ — Step 1 (SETUP): create a task titled 'Bulk archive A', mark it complete. Step 2 (SETUP): create a task titled 'Bulk archive B', mark it complete. Step 3 (VERIFY): click the 'Archive completed' button at the bottom of the task list. Step 4 (VERIFY): confirm both completed tasks are removed from the active list (they now appear on the Archive page). Stay on the AUT - do NOT navigate to any kaneai-playground or ecommerce-playground site. Stop immediately once confirmed. Do not navigate further.
